💡 This review uniquely frames hydrogel electrolytes as programmable, cross-scale platforms rather than passive quasi-solid media. Its novelty lies in a unified framework linking molecular interactions, network architecture, and interfacial engineering to nine regulation strategies. item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers tailoring carbon vacancies via conformational pre-organization of precursor architecture. These vacancies enable fast Na+ diffusion, homogenize interfacial electric fields, and exclude solvents, boosting interfacial stability. The optimized hard carbon anodes achieve ultra-long cycle life (16,000 cycles at 1.0 A g−1) and excellent low-temperature performance, establishing a new design paradigm for durable sodium-ion battery anodes.

item.title: Medium‐Concentration Electrolytes Balance Hydrogen‐Bond Disruption and Ion–Ion Interactions for Wide‐Temperature Aqueous Trivalent Indium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work shows medium-concentration chloride electrolytes, not maximum concentration, optimally balance hydrogen-bond disruption and ion–ion interactions. The 1 m InCl₃ + 10 m LiCl electrolyte enables wide-temperature aqueous trivalent indium batteries (−70 to +65 °C) with high Coulombic efficiency (99–99.95%), suppressing freezing and water-induced side reactions. It establishes solvation-structure tuning as key to wide-temperature aqueous trivalent electrolytes.

item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The study introduces a Janus Ag nanoskin-armored polyimide bilayer separator that regulates lithium nucleation via a lithiophilic 3D host, suppressing dendrite growth. item.title: Tailoring Cathode Interphase with Cyclic Ethers toward Stable Lithium‐Metal Batteries
item.description:
ساختار حلقه اترهای حلقوی، ترمودینامیک باز شدن حلقه و تشکیل CEI را در باتری‌های لیتیوم-فلز تنظیم می‌کند و DOL برای LiFePO4 و DOX برای NCM811 پایداری بهتری می‌دهد.
ENERGY & ENVIRONMENTAL MATERIALS | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work reveals that cyclic ether ring structure controls ring-opening thermodynamics and cathode interphase chemistry in lithium-metal batteries. Comparing DOL and DOX shows distinct interfacial pathways: DOL enables stable LiFePO₄ cycling, while DOX stabilizes high-voltage NCM811. The findings establish interfacial reactivity matching as a design principle for tailoring ether electrolytes, advancing durable lithium-metal batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · cathode electrolyte interphase · cyclic ether electrolyte · LiFePO4 cathode · NCM811 cathode

item.title: Beyond Phase Selectivity in Conversion Copper Selenides Cathode through Activated Anionic Redox
item.description:
فعال‌سازی ردوکس آنیونی در کاتد سلنید مس، ظرفیت CuSe را از ۴ به ۴۱۳ mAh g–1 افزایش داد و باتری روی با عمر ۴۰۰۰ چرخه را ممکن ساخت.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work shows that activating selenium anionic redox overcomes phase-selectivity limits in copper selenide cathodes, converting zincophobic CuSe into a high-capacity electrode (4 to 413 mAh g⁻¹, doubled voltage, 4000-cycle life). It enables the whole CuySe family as stable zinc-battery cathodes and generalizes to other nucleophilic additives, revitalizing a dormant material class.
